en.headline: Hong Kong retail sales rise 6.4 per cent in September, 17th straight month of growth
en.dek: Provisional figures show total sales value at HK$33.4 billion, with online sales up 12 per cent and jewellery leading category gains.
body: Hong Kong's total retail sales value rose 6.4 per cent year on year to a provisional HK$33.4 billion in September, the Census and Statistics Department said on Tuesday. The pace quickened from a revised 5.6 per cent increase in August and marked the 17th consecutive month of expansion.

After adjusting for price changes, the volume of retail sales increased 3.9 per cent. Online sales accounted for 13.1 per cent of the total, with their value provisionally estimated at HK$4.4 billion, up 12 per cent from a year earlier. For the first nine months of 2026, total retail sales value rose 8.3 per cent and online sales 21.2 per cent.

Growth was broad-based. Jewellery, watches, clocks and valuable gifts rose 20.3 per cent, electrical goods and other durables 9.7 per cent, and clothing 11.1 per cent. A government spokesman attributed the acceleration to solid local consumption sentiment, higher visitor arrivals and festive purchases linked to an earlier Mid-Autumn Festival.

The spokesman said sustained economic expansion and growth in labour earnings should continue to support local consumption, while upcoming mega events, festive celebrations and inbound tourism would add further momentum to the retail sector.

zh.headline: 本港9月零售業銷貨值按年升6.4% 連升17個月
zh.dek: 臨時估計總銷貨價值334億元，網上銷售升12%，珠寶鐘錶等類別升幅顯著。
body: 政府統計處周二公布，本港今年9月零售業總銷貨價值臨時估計為334億元，按年上升6.4%，升幅較8月修訂數字的5.6%加快，並連續第17個月錄得擴張。
扣除價格變動後，9月零售業總銷貨數量按年上升3.9%。網上銷售佔總值13.1%，價值臨時估計44億元，按年升12%。首九個月合計，總銷貨價值按年升8.3%，網上銷售升21.2%。
增長面廣泛，珠寶首飾、鐘錶及名貴禮物銷貨價值按年升20.3%，電器及其他未分類耐用消費品升9.7%，服裝升11.1%。政府發言人表示，本地消費氣氛普遍穩健，訪港旅客增加及較早的中秋節帶動節日貨品銷售，均有助月內整體增長。
發言人指，經濟持續擴張及就業收入增長將支持本地消費，未來盛事、節慶活動及訪港旅遊業增長亦會為零售業增添動力。
